name: Residual Wilds
summary:
Residual Wilds is an indie 2D action and exploration game with a pixel art style, set in a hostile and mysterious post-apocalyptic world.

You play as FV8, a robot who awakens alone in a land where civilization has long since vanished. As you journey through dangerous biomes, you will face strange creatures, manage limited resources, and uncover fragments of the story behind a broken world.

The game blends platforming, combat, and survival. It is not just about moving forward. You must choose when to fight, when to flee, and how to use what you find to increase your chances of survival. Exploration is essential, with hidden areas, environmental storytelling, and secrets scattered throughout the world.

Residual Wilds is developed by a single creator and focuses on delivering an atmospheric, challenging, and honest experience, where every step forward feels earned and every discovery matters. A lonely, harsh, and melancholic journey through a world that no longer waits for anyone.
